backend.runtime_platform: GitHub-hosted Ubuntu Linux desktop integration test under xvfb
backend.model_weight_hashes: computed in CI from the exact pinned checkout

why_full_mode: The backend's faceOnly mode can return at most one face; PILOT_001 requires two cats. Full mode performs body detection followed by per-cat face localization and 48-point landmarks.

required_before_admission: independent validation of landmark accuracy on reviewed frames or a justified benchmark transfer

claim_ceiling: This backend may generate candidate 48-point geometry for review and model development. Its outputs are not ground truth and cannot by themselves establish PILOT_001 landmarks_48, facial_action_onset, delta_t, or INDEPENDENT_FRAME_LEVEL_ESTIMATE.
